# Irene Turner - Sonoma Style

> > Luxury lifestyle services for Sonoma County Wine Country, specializing in real estate acquisition, property management, interior design, and concierge services.

Irene Turner's Sonoma Style offers comprehensive lifestyle and property services throughout Sonoma County's Wine Country, including areas like Healdsburg, Graton, and Occidental. The portfolio showcases luxury real estate, vacation rental management, custom interior design projects, and personalized concierge services for discerning clients in California's premier wine region.
